description: This Kotlin source file defines the UI components and functions for a chat interface in an Android app using Jetpack Compose. It manages chat session selection, message display, error reporting, image attachments, and auto-sending prompts, interacting with a ViewModel for state management.

classes.name: PendingImageAttachment
classes.description: Data class representing an image attachment pending upload, including id, filename, MIME type, and base64-encoded content.

methods.name: resolvePendingAssistantAutoSend
methods.description: Determines whether to auto-send a pending prompt based on input conditions.

methods.name: dispatchPendingAssistantAutoSend
methods.description: Suspends and attempts to dispatch the auto-send prompt if conditions are met.

methods.name: loadSizedImageAttachment
methods.description: Loads and resizing an image attachment from a URI; used for managing image uploads.

methods.name: resolveSessionChoices
methods.description: Generates a list of session options for selection.

methods.name: friendlySessionName
methods.description: Formats a session name for display.
